chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: '1966 round 50 cent lot' and '8 x 1966 round 50c', filter sold last 90 days, note per-coin price for lots of 5-10 and the grade. Also eBay sold 'silver 80% 50c 1966 bulk'. Noble Numismatics past results (noble.com.au) for 'silver fifty cents 1966' lots of 5-12 coins, and Leski/Downies results for the same. Also check the current AUD silver spot price to set the melt floor (about 2.73 oz fine). Search 'double bar' to check whether any coin is the scarce variety.
viewing_check: Turn the coins over and check obverses for the double-bar variety (worth far more). Check the spotted coin and whether any are cleaned.
rate_note: All prices AUD, rate 1.0. Noble prices are hammer, buyer's premium not included. Melt value not stated because no spot price was seen. Per-coin resale evidence of about AU$22-45 per coin implies roughly AU$180-300 for 8 on the open market (eBay bulk $302 for 8 equivalent; Noble about $290-300), while local rooms ran $150-220 for 8.
